purpose: Freeze exactly what Sprint 21D2 inherits and fix its permitted role before any D2 corpus exists. Every figure below came from a SQL SELECT or a file read; no application service was used, so no access row was written to an inherited store.
authority_rule: Backlog section 0.3: all 214 released C3/D1 outcomes are real governed evidence. They are available for surface diagnosis, historical development comparison and retained evaluation. They are not available for training, calibration, threshold choice or artifact exemplars.

deferred_correction_ranking_examples.definition: The 120 candidate runs of the 30 offline coding tasks, four per task. These are the examples that made experience.correction_ranking the only balanced D1 candidate.
deferred_correction_ranking_examples.permitted_d2_use: surface diagnosis and historical development comparison only
deferred_correction_ranking_examples.prohibited_d2_use: training, calibration, threshold choice, artifact exemplars

graph_evidence.permitted_d2_use: Development and regression diagnostic only. Backlog section 2.3: rerunning the frozen D1 80 queries is diagnostic evidence, not Gate D1 condition 15 closure.

embedding_identity.rule: D2 pins the same identity. A second embedding model is out of scope.

cognitive_os_s21c3_test.note: Revalidates sprint-21d1-c3-inventory.json. The store was never emptied between C3 waves, so it holds rehearsal executions alongside the released campaign and is not the authority for any released count.

cognitive_os_s21d1_test.note: D1 fitted nothing and activated nothing, so it projected no learned observation. The inherited learned plane is empty apart from C3's intake.

cognitive_os_s21d2_test.note: The D2 store starts empty. Every D2 observation will be created by D2.

negative_training_membership_proof.claim: Zero inherited real-run observation is eligible for D2 training or calibration, and no D2 fitting snapshot can reach one.
structural_argument: Every one of the 960 learned observations in the C3 store has provenance_class = real_governed_run. None is self-play, so none is training-eligible under the existing LearnedDatasetBuilder rule that drops non-training-eligible rows from a TRAINING corpus.
The D1 store holds zero learned observations, so it contributes none.

D2 reads and writes cognitive_os_s21d2_test, a separate database that starts with zero learned observations. The C3 and D1 stores are not connected to it, so a D2 training snapshot cannot select a row that lives in them.
The 120 deferred correction-ranking examples are identified here by digest so any later D2 training or calibration manifest can be checked against them directly.

forbidden_identity_digests.algorithm: sha256 of the newline-joined sorted identity strings

negative_training_membership_proof.check_rule: A D2 training or calibration manifest is invalid if any member resolves to an outcome identity in sprint-21d1-outcome-view.json, or to any observation whose provenance_class is real_governed_run. Both checks are membership tests, not sampling.

consequences_for_d2: Gate D1 condition 6 cannot be closed by the 214 inherited outcomes; it needs new final D2 evidence.
Gate D1 condition 15 cannot be closed by the frozen 80 D1 queries; it needs a new unseen-task holdout.
The 120 deferred examples justify selecting experience.correction_ranking as a candidate. They may not be relabelled as D2 training under any campaign.
Re-executing a rights-cleared task under a new SELF_PLAY campaign is permitted only as a new observation with new provenance and a group excluded from every D2 final and canary set.
